annotation.authors_or_issuer: Senado Federal do Brasil - Comissão de Juristas (CJSUBIA)
key_provisions_or_claims: Temporary commission of jurists created to support a substitute text for Brazilian AI bills PL 5051/2019, PL 21/2020 and PL 872/2021
Installed 30 March 2022; deadline extended to December 2022
Final report presented 1 Dec and delivered 6 Dec 2022
Page lists meetings, communications and committee documents but not the report text
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian Federal Senate portal page for the closed CJSUBIA, a commission of jurists that supported drafting a substitute text for AI bills PL 5051/2019, PL 21/2020 and PL 872/2021. It lists meetings, notices and documents, including the final report approved in December 2022.
annotation.title_clean: CJSUBIA - Comissão de Juristas responsável por subsidiar elaboração de substitutivo sobre inteligência artificial no Brasil
annotation.title_en: CJSUBIA - Commission of Jurists responsible for supporting the drafting of a substitute bill on artificial intelligence in Brazil
